decisions.reason: As a recently expanded aftercare product that moved from a simple mention to its own webpage, it has visible commitment, fits the firm’s established flooring-care offer, and disappointing early results could easily be treated as temporary.

Although it only remained website-mentioned rather than strongly promoted, this multi-model maintenance oil builds directly on the installed base of wooden floors, so prior development effort and cross-selling logic still favor continuation.
This care line gained its own page by 2024, signaling stronger public commitment and investment, and it is closely tied to the firm’s core promise of maintaining wood floors over their life cycle.

The moisture-protection underlay is a practical accessory to the core flooring system, and even with only modest website visibility the firm is likely to persist because it complements the main offer and can be justified as needing more market time.

This underlay foam looks somewhat more peripheral and easier to rationalize away than core flooring products, but escalation of commitment and its role in a system offer still make retention more likely than withdrawal.

As a parquet line with several models that sits very close to the firm’s established business, it carries substantial sunk effort, strategic relevance, and reputational commitment, all of which strongly support keeping it on the market.
